chunks: And to 'Ad was sent their brother Hud, who said: 'O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are only inventing lies.'

key_terms.الْإِلَٰه: Deity or god, referring to the object of worship
key_terms.عَادٍ: The tribe of 'Ad, known for their strength and polytheism
key_terms.مُفْتَرُونَ: Inventors of lies, those who fabricate falsehoods
key_terms.هُودًا: Hud, the prophet sent to the tribe of 'Ad

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud say to the people of 'Ad regarding their idols?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the core message of Tawhid by contrasting the divine reality with the human fabrication of idols, a theme central to the narrative of the 'Ad people's arrogance. The term 'mufitaruna' (fabricators) highlights that their polytheism was not based on truth but on invented falsehoods, a concept often linked to the concept of 'Bada' in understanding divine judgment. This call to monotheism serves as a precursor to the eventual destruction of the 'Ad, illustrating the consequence of rejecting the prophetic message.
